# Provenance + integrity record for the vendored report scripts (#332).
# The sha256s below are ENFORCED by report_vendor_test.go
# (TestVendoredReportScriptHashes). An upgrade is the full #332 recipe: the
# vendored blob + the sha256 here + the go:embed list and vendorScripts names
# in report.go + the template literals + the test pins — all in one commit.
# Tampering in git is detectable. Renovate never touches this file:
# config:recommended's :ignoreModulesAndTests preset adds **/vendor/** to
# ignorePaths (verified: a no-extends config extracts it, the preset one
# does not) and the standard ignores are deliberately not overridden —
# provenance here is hand-maintained.
#
# tailwindcss-3.4.17.js
#   source: https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17
#   note: the Play CDN build — a runtime JIT CSS compiler, documented by
#         upstream as development-only. DESIGN TRADE-OFF (accepted, #332):
#         vendoring the compiler keeps the report self-contained (it is the
#         artifact cdn.tailwindcss.com serves; the only published form) at
#         the cost of ~407KB and a compiler-in-browser. A prebuilt CSS via
#         the tailwind CLI would be 10-30KB and drop one of the two inline
#         script blocks — recorded as the follow-up direction.
#   ARTIFACT-SPACE CEILING (verified 2026-09-05): cdn.tailwindcss.com serves
#         the Play CDN build up to 3.4.17 ONLY — 3.4.18+ and the v4 line
#         return an "Unknown Tailwind version" stub. npm:tailwindcss has
#         releases past 3.4.17, so renovate's npm-datasource notifier will
#         propose versions with NO published Play-CDN artifact — those
#         branches are read-before-acting: verify the CDN actually serves
#         the version before attempting this recipe.
#   sha256: 176e894661aa9cdc9a5cba6c720044cbbf7b8bd80d1c9a142a7c24b1b6c50d15
#

#     (the fetched tarball hashes to it; its inner dist/chart.umd.min.js is the
#      bytes below — jsdelivr serves the same file, both verified 2026-09-05)
